rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Electrical work.** Moving charge q through potential V costs W = qV = VIt; in a pure resistance this equals I²Rt = V²t/R — the energy converted.  ·  **Electric power.** P = VI = I²R = V²/R, measured in watts; 1 horsepower ≈ 746 W and commercial rating is often in kW.  ·  **Energy unit.** 1 kWh (one 'unit' on a meter bill) = 3.6 × 10⁶ J — the energy a 1000 W appliance uses in an hour.
